summary: Frontend testing of new fullscreen 'Ver galería' lightbox inside DayImageGallery on /viajes/atlas_desierto/programa_4n_5d. All critical flows pass: button visible, lightbox opens, counter/image/close/prev/next/thumb-strip render, next arrow + thumb click + ArrowRight/ArrowLeft keys navigate correctly, Escape closes, X closes, body scroll-lock is applied while open and restored on close, z-index 9999 (above header), no JS console errors. Found 1 minor UX deviation on backdrop-click behavior.

ui_bugs.issue: Clicking the dark background NEXT TO the image (the empty letterbox area around the ) does NOT close the lightbox. The outer dialog's onClick only fires when e.target===e.currentTarget, but the visible 'dark area beside the image' is actually the INNER flex-1 container (px-4 md:px-20). So clicks at e.g. (5,200) land on the inner div instead of the dialog root, and the lightbox stays open. Only clicks on the very top-bar / thumb-strip gaps (direct children of the dialog) close it. The spec explicitly says 'haciendo clic en el fondo oscuro fuera de la imagen' should close. Fix: also attach the same conditional onClick handler to the inner flex-1 image container, or replace the img with absolute-positioned and put pointer-events:none on non-button overlays.

action_items: (Optional / LOW) Make backdrop-click closing work over the full dark area around the image, not just on the outer dialog's direct empty zones. Easiest fix: add the same `if (e.target === e.currentTarget) setLightboxOpen(false)` onClick to the inner 'flex-1 min-h-0 flex items-center justify-center' container.
critical_code_review_comments: DayImageGallery.jsx is ~480 lines and aggregates main viewer + thumb rail + lightbox + inline editor — consider splitting the lightbox into its own component (e.g. DayGalleryLightbox.jsx) to keep each file <300 lines and reduce cognitive load.

Keyboard handler in lightbox useEffect depends on [lightboxOpen, total] but uses `go` from outer scope which closes over `total` via state — currently safe (go reads `total` from closure each render), but adding `go` to deps or memoizing it would be more idiomatic.
Backdrop close logic relies on identity check `e.target === e.currentTarget`, which is fragile for nested flex layouts (see UI bug above).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Lightbox tested on day 'dia-1' of /viajes/atlas_desierto/programa_4n_5d (10 slides). Found 5 'Ver galería' buttons (one per day). Open/close/prev/next/thumb/keyboard all verified. Only deviation: backdrop click in the central dark area around the image does not close because click target is the inner flex container, not the outer dialog. No console errors observed.
rca of the issue: Reproduction: open https://morocco-trips-2.preview.emergentagent.com/viajes/atlas_desierto/programa_4n_5d, scroll to Día 1 gallery, click 'Ver galería', then click in the dark area to the left/right of the centered image. Expected: lightbox closes. Actual: stays open. Cause: onClick handler only on outer dialog with strict target===currentTarget check; the visible dark margins around the image belong to a child div. Mitigation: replicate the same handler on the image-container div, or render the inside an element that fills the dialog with the img absolutely centered.
